public_signal: Mistral continues to launch multilingual and document-intelligence models for enterprise use, increasing the need for domain and language evaluation.
partnership_hypothesis: European expert evaluation with 23-language coverage, sovereign data handling and regulated-domain task design.
illustrative_entry_offer: French/English document-intelligence pilot in legal or financial services with expert rubrics.
caveat: Do not infer a formal need from product launch alone.

public_signal: DeepL reports 48,000 blind tests with language experts across 16 language pairs for its translator launch.
partnership_hypothesis: Scalable, verified professional adjudication for specialist terminology, regional variation and high-stakes translation quality.
illustrative_entry_offer: Expert comparison pilot in one regulated domain across three European language pairs.
caveat: DeepL already uses experts; wedge must be incremental quality, speed or provenance.

public_signal: Gemini Robotics ER 2 highlights video understanding, task orchestration and multi-robot collaboration—capabilities requiring real-world and expert evaluation.
partnership_hypothesis: Independent expert evaluation of embodied reasoning, task safety and multilingual instructions across European operating contexts.
illustrative_entry_offer: Expert-designed robotics reasoning benchmark with edge cases and qualitative adjudication.
caveat: Large strategic account; access and procurement complexity materially reduce near-term probability.

public_signal: ElevenLabs has published a six-pillar voice-agent evaluation framework and operates across many languages and industries.
partnership_hypothesis: Native-language professionals to evaluate task completion, pronunciation, policy adherence and domain accuracy in voice agents.
illustrative_entry_offer: Two-language financial-services voice-agent eval with expert scorecards and failure clips.
caveat: Use synthetic or authorised audio only; no customer recordings without a lawful basis.

public_signal: Agile Robots says it will train a foundation model on European infrastructure using real production data and that its systems learn from extensive training data.
partnership_hypothesis: Sovereign European expert/task data and independent evaluation for industrial foundation-model adaptation.
illustrative_entry_offer: German manufacturing benchmark: expert tasks, acceptance rubric and error adjudication.
caveat: Warm-route score is a hypothesis based on European ecosystem proximity, not a known relationship.

public_signal: 1X's World Model Lab explicitly combines web media, egocentric human video, simulation, remote-operated robot data and on-policy data; it calls data the durable moat.
partnership_hypothesis: European egocentric expert data, remote-operation cohorts and independent task-level evaluation with clear consent/provenance.
illustrative_entry_offer: Norway/EU pilot for one household or light-industrial task family with expert task design and adjudication.
caveat: Strongest explicit data signal; confirm data rights, privacy and physical capture capability.

public_signal: NEURA describes physical-AI foundation models using memory plus vision, touch and audio, and a data platform for shared intelligence across robot fleets.
partnership_hypothesis: European specialist demonstrations and multimodal evaluation for cognitive robots in industrial settings.
illustrative_entry_offer: German industrial task pilot: expert specification, edge-case catalogue and multimodal evaluation rubric.
caveat: Potentially strong geographic fit; physical capture scope and partner access remain unknown.

public_signal: PI's π0.7 integrates data from multiple robots, control modalities, human videos and autonomous data.
partnership_hypothesis: Commissioned expert demonstrations and adjudicated task evaluation in specialist European environments.
illustrative_entry_offer: Pilot with 50–100 expert-designed manipulation tasks plus failure adjudication in one domain.
caveat: High technical and delivery complexity; requires robotics-specific operating partner.

public_signal: BBVA launched shared AI architecture to accelerate model development, validation and deployment, including automated governance controls.
partnership_hypothesis: Independent multilingual evaluation of customer-facing, risk and internal AI with European professional experts and audit-ready evidence.
illustrative_entry_offer: Fixed-price independent evaluation of one customer-facing AI workflow across Spanish and English.
caveat: No public evidence of supplier appetite; procurement and data access require qualification.

public_signal: Santander is scaling generative and agentic AI and in 2026 published AI projects as open source to support trustworthy banking AI.
partnership_hypothesis: Independent European banking-expert evaluation for trustworthy agentic AI, language coverage and governed deployment.
illustrative_entry_offer: Spanish/English banking-agent benchmark using synthetic customer cases and expert adjudication.
caveat: Open-source activity provides a legitimate research surface but not permission to represent Santander.

public_signal: Allianz and Anthropic announced a global partnership covering workforce AI, agentic automation and regulatory compliance; Allianz also leads a 2026 insurance AI index.
partnership_hypothesis: Independent insurance-expert evaluation for claims, underwriting and agentic AI, with human-in-the-loop and EU evidence.
illustrative_entry_offer: Claims-agent evaluation using synthetic cases across German and English, including escalation and bias tests.
caveat: Existing strategic partners may be both an entry signal and a vendor-displacement barrier.

public_signal: BNP Paribas extended its Mistral partnership for GenAI deployment, including sensitive KYC workflows with expert validation of risks and decisions.
partnership_hypothesis: Independent financial-crime and compliance expert evaluation with provenance, multilingual cases and human adjudication.
illustrative_entry_offer: Fixed-price KYC workflow evaluation using synthetic cases; test accuracy, escalation and explanation quality.
caveat: KYC is sensitive; use synthetic/de-identified data and avoid claims of compliance certification.
